import json
import base64
import subprocess as sp

repo = 'repos/organvm-iii-ergon/collaboration-operations-platform'
required = [
    'packages/contracts/src/index.ts',
    'packages/contracts/src/base.ts',
    'packages/contracts/src/enums.ts',
    'packages/contracts/src/command.ts',
    'packages/contracts/src/query.ts',
    'packages/contracts/src/event.ts',
    'packages/contracts/src/job.ts',
    'packages/contracts/package.json',
    'packages/contracts/README.md',
    'packages/contracts/scripts/validate-contracts.mjs',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/envelope.command.json',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/envelope.query.json',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/envelope.event.json',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/receipt.json',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/problem.json',
    'packages/contracts/schemas/job.json',
    'packages/contracts/src/api.ts',
    'packages/contracts/src/compatibility.ts',
    'packages/contracts/fixtures/api-v1/contract.json',
    'packages/contracts/fixtures/api-v1/person.create.command.fixture.json',
    'packages/contracts/fixtures/api-v1/person.created.event.fixture.json',
    'packages/contracts/fixtures/api-v1/engagement.create.command.fixture.json',
    'packages/contracts/fixtures/api-v1/engagement.timeline.query.fixture.json',
    'packages/contracts/fixtures/api-v1/commitment.create.command.fixture.json',
    'packages/contracts/fixtures/api-v1/commitment.update.command.fixture.json',
    'packages/contracts/fixtures/compatibility.json',
]
for path in required:
    payload = sp.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/{path}'], text=True)
    obj = json.loads(payload)
    assert obj.get('type') == 'file', f'{path} missing or not file'

index_content = base64.b64decode(json.loads(sp.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/packages/contracts/src/index.ts'], text=True))['content']).decode('utf-8')
assert './api' in index_content and './compatibility' in index_content, 'api/compat exports missing'

validate_content = base64.b64decode(json.loads(sp.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/packages/contracts/scripts/validate-contracts.mjs'], text=True))['content']).decode('utf-8')
assert 'DELTA-03 contract and fixture' in validate_content, 'validate content check failed'

contract = json.loads(base64.b64decode(json.loads(sp.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/packages/contracts/fixtures/api-v1/contract.json'], text=True))['content']).decode('utf-8'))
assert contract.get('version') == '1.0.0' and contract.get('resources'), 'contract invalid'

compat = json.loads(base64.b64decode(json.loads(sp.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/packages/contracts/fixtures/compatibility.json'], text=True))['content']).decode('utf-8'))
assert compat.get('resourceMatrix', {}).get('person'), 'compatibility invalid'

api = base64.b64decode(json.loads(sp.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/packages/contracts/src/api.ts'], text=True))['content']).decode('utf-8')
assert 'API_RESOURCES' in api, 'api contract not present'

compat_ts = base64.b64decode(json.loads(sp.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/packages/contracts/src/compatibility.ts'], text=True))['content']).decode('utf-8')
assert 'COMPATIBILITY_CATALOG' in compat_ts, 'compatibility catalog missing'

pkg = json.loads(base64.b64decode(json.loads(sp.check_output(['gh', 'api', f'{repo}/contents/packages/contracts/package.json'], text=True))['content']).decode('utf-8'))
assert pkg.get('scripts', {}).get('validate') == 'node scripts/validate-contracts.mjs', 'validate command missing'

print('PASS: DELTA-03 contract and compatibility artifacts verified in target repo')
PY
